arabic_text: يَا مَنْ يَرْحَمُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُهُ الْعِبَادُ.
transliteration: yā man yarḥamu man lā yarḥamuhu al-ʿibād
english_text: O He who has mercy upon him toward whom the servants show no mercy!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَقْبَلُ مَنْ لا تَقْبَلُهُ الْبِلاَدُ.
transliteration: wayā man yaqbalu man lā taqbaluhu albilād
english_text: O He who accepts him whom the cities will not accept!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَن لاَ يَحْتَقِرُ أَهْلَ الْحَاجَةِ إلَيْهِ.
transliteration: wa yā man lā yahtaqiru ahl al-ḥājaẗi ilayh
english_text: O He who looks not down upon those who have need of Him!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُخَيِّبُ المَلِحِّيْنَ عَلَيْـهِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā yukhayyibu al-malihhīna ʿalayhi
english_text: O He who disappoints not those who implore Him!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لاَ يَجْبَهُ بِالرَّدِّ أَهْلَ الدَّالَّةِ عَليهِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā yajbahū bi-r-raddi ahlad-dāllati ʿalayhi
english_text: O He who slaps not the brow of the people of boldness toward Him with rejection!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَجْتَبِي صَغِيرَ مَايُتْحَفُ بِهِ، وَيَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا يُعْمَلُ لَهُ.
transliteration: wa yā man yajtabi ṣaghīra mayutḥafu bihī wa yashkur yasira ma yu'malu lahu
english_text: O He who collects the little that is given to Him and shows gratitude for the paltry that is done for Him!

arabic_text: وَيَامَنْ يَشْكُرُ عَلَى الْقَلِيْلِ، وَيُجَازيْ بِالْجَلِيلِ،
transliteration: wa yaman yashkur ʿalal-qaleel, wa yujāzi bil-jaleel
english_text: O He who shows gratitude for the small and rewards with the great!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَدْنُو إلَى مَنْ دَنا مِنْهُ
transliteration: wayā man yadnū ʾilā man dana minhu
english_text: O He who comes close to him who comes close to Him!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يَدعُو إلَى نَفْسِهِ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ عَنْهُ،
transliteration: wayā man yadʿū ilā nafsihi man ʾadbar ʿanhū
english_text: O He who invites to Himself him who turns his back on Him!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لا يُغَيِّرُ النِّعْمَةَ، وَلا يُبَادِرُ بِالنَّقِمَةِ،
transliteration: wa yā man lā yughayyiru al-niʿmata, wa lā yubādiru bi al-naqimah
english_text: O He who changes not favour and rushes not to vengeance!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ يُثْمِرُ الْحَسَنَةَ حَتَّى يُنْمِيَهَا، وَيَتَجَاوَزُ عَنِ السَّيِّئَةِ حَتَّى يُعَفِّيَهَا.
transliteration: wayā man yuthmiru al-ḥasanah ḥattá yunmiyahā wa yatajaawazu ʿani as-sayyiʾati hatta yuʿaffiyahaa
english_text: O He who causes the good deed to bear fruit so that He may make it grow, and overlooks the evil deed so that He may efface it!

arabic_text: انْصَرَفَتِ الآمَالُ دُونَ مَدى كَرَمِكَ بِالحَاجَاتِ وَامْتَلاَتْ بِفَيْضِ جُودِكَ أَوْعِيَةُ الطَّلِبات، وَتَفَسَّخَتْ دُونَ بُلُوغِ نَعْتِـكَ الصِّفَاتُ،
transliteration: 'inṣarafatil-āmālu dūna madā karamika bil-ḥājāt' waamtalat bifaḍi judika aw`iyatu alṭṭalibat wa tafassakhat dunā bulūghin naʿtika al-ṣifātu
english_text: Hopes turn back with needs fulfilled short of the extent of Thy generosity, the cups of requests fill up with the overflow of Thy munificence, and attributes fall apart without reaching Thy description.

arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْعُلُوُّ الأعْلَى فَوْقَ كُلِّ عَال، وَالْجَلاَلُ الأمْجَدُ فَوْقَ كُلِّ جَلاَل،
transliteration: falakal-'uluwwul-a'la fawqa kulli 'aal wa al-jalālu al-amjadu fawqa kulli jalāl
english_text: For to Thee belongs the highest highness above everything high, and the most glorious majesty beyond every majesty!

arabic_text: كُلُّ جَلِيْل عِنْدَكَ صَغِيرٌ، وَكُلُّ شَرِيف فِي جَنْبِ شَرَفِكَ حَقِيرٌ،
transliteration: kullu jaliilin 'indaka saghiirun wa kullu sharifin fi janbi sharafika haqirun
english_text: Everything majestic before Thee is small, everything eminent beside Thy eminence vile!

arabic_text: خَابَ الْوَافِدُونَ عَلَى غَيْرِكَ، وَخَسِرَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ إلاَّ لَكَ، وَضَاعَ الْمُلِمُّونَ إلاّ بِكَ، وَأَجْدَبَ الْمُنْتَجِعُـونَ إلاَّ مَنِ انْتَجَعَ فَضْلَكَ،
transliteration: khaba al-wāfidūn ʿalā ghayrika wa khasira al-mutaʿarriḍūna illā laka, wa ḍāʿa al-mulimmūna illā bika wa-ajdaba al-muntajiʿūna illā mani intajʿa fadluka
english_text: Those who reach other than Thee are disappointed, those who present themselves to other than Thee have lost, those who stay with other than Thee have perished, and those who retreat - except those who retreat to Thy bounty - are desolate!

arabic_text: بَابُكَ مَفْتُوحٌ لِلرَّاغِبِينَ، وَجُودُكَ مُبَاحٌ لِلسَّائِلِينَ، وَإغاثَتُكَ قَرِيبَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْتَغِيْثِينَ،
transliteration: bābuka mafṭūḥun lil-rāghibīn, wa-jūduka mubāḥun li-lsāʾilīn wa-ighāthatuka qarībatun min al-mustaghīthīn
english_text: Thy door is open to the beseechers, Thy munificence free to the askers, Thy help near to the help-seekers!

arabic_text: لاَ يَخِيبُ مِنْـكَ الآمِلُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسُ مِنْ عَطَائِكَ الْمُتَعَرِّضُونَ، وَلا يَشْقَى بِنَقْمَتِكَ الْمُسْتَغْفِرُونَ.
transliteration: lā yakhību minkal-āmilūn, wa lā yayʾasu min ʿatāʾika al-mutaʿarridūn walā yashqā binaqmatika al-mustaghfirūn
english_text: The expectant are not disappointed by Thee, those who present themselves despair not of Thy bestowal, the forgiveness-seekers become not wretched through Thy vengeance!

arabic_text: رِزْقُكَ مَبْسُوطٌ لِمَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَحِلْمُكَ مُعْتَـرِضٌ لِمَنْ نَاوَاكَ، عَادَتُكَ الإحْسَـانُ إلَى الْمُسِيئينَ، وَسُنَّتُـكَ الإبْقَاءُ عَلَى الْمُعْتَدِينَ
transliteration: rizquka mabsootun liman ʿasak wa ḥil-muka muʿtaridhun liman naawaka ʿādatuka al-iḥsānu ilā al-musīʾīn wa sunnatuka al-ibqā'u ʿalā al-muʿtadīn
english_text: Thy provision is spread among those who disobey Thee, Thy clemency presents itself to those hostile toward Thee, Thy habit is beneficence toward the evildoers, and Thy wont is to spare the transgressors,

arabic_text: حَتَّى لَقَدْ غَرَّتْهُمْ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِ الرُّجُوعِ، وَصَدَّهُمْ إمْهَالُكَ عَن النُّزُوعِ.
transliteration: ḥattá laqad ghar-rathum ʾanātuka ʿanir-rujūʿi waṣaddahum ʾimhāluka ʿan an-nuzūʿi
english_text: so much so that Thy lack of haste deludes them from returning, and Thy disregard bars them from desisting!

arabic_text: وَإنَّمَا تَأَنَّيْتَ بهمْ لِيَفِيئُوا إلَى أَمْرِكَ، وَأَمْهَلْتَهُمْ ثِقَةً بِدَوَامِ مُلْكِكَ، فَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّعَادَةِ خَتَمْتَ لَهُ بِهَا، وَمَنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الشَّقَاوَةِ خَذَلْتَهُ لَهَا،
transliteration: wa innamā taʾannayta bihim liyafee'u ilā amrik wa'amhaltahum thiqatan bidawami mulkika faman kana min ahli al-saʿādah khatamta lahū bihā wa-man kaana min ahli ash-shaqawaati khadhalatahu lahā
english_text: Thou actest without haste toward them so that they will come back to Thy command and Thou disregardest them confident in the permanence of Thy kingdom, so Thou sealest him who is worthy of it with felicity, and Thou abandonest him who is worthy of it to wretchedness!

arabic_text: كُلُّهُمْ صَائِرُونَ إلَى حُكْمِكَ وَأُمُورُهُمْ آئِلَةٌ إلَى أَمْـرِكَ،
transliteration: kulluhum sa'iroon ila hukmika wa umooruhum ailatun ila amrik
english_text: All of them come home to Thy decree, their affairs revert to Thy command;

arabic_text: لَمْ يَهِنْ عَلَى طُـولِ مُـدَّتِهِمْ سُلْطَانُـكَ وَلَمْ يَـدْحَضْ لِتَـرْكِ مُعَاجَلَتِهِمْ بُرْهَانُكَ.
transliteration: lam yahin ʿalá ṭūli muddatihim sultānuk walam yadhaḍ li-tariki muʿājalatihim burhānuka
english_text: Thy authority grows not feeble through their drawn out term, Thy proof is not refuted by the failure to hurry after them.

arabic_text: حُجَّتُكَ قَائِمَةٌ لاَ تُدْحَضُ، وَسُلْطَانُكَ ثَابِتٌ لا يَزُولُ،
transliteration: ḥujjatuka qāʾimah lā tudhaḍḍh wa sulṭānuka thābitun lā yazūl
english_text: Thy argument is established, never refuted, Thy authority fixed, never removed.

arabic_text: فَالْوَيْلُ الدَّائِمُ لِمَنْ جَنَحَ عَنْكَ، وَالْخَيْبَةُ الْخَاذِلَةُ لِمَنْ خَابَ مِنْكَ، وَالشَّقاءُ الاشْقَى لِمَنِ اغْتَرَّ بِكَ.
transliteration: fa al-waylu al-da'imu liman janaha 'anka wal-khaybah al-khāẓilah liman khāba minka wa alshshaqā'u alashqa li mani ightarra bika
english_text: Permanent woe belongs to him who inclines away from Thee, forsaking disappointment to him who is disappointed by Thee, and the most wretched wretchedness to him who is deluded about Thee!

arabic_text: مَا أكْثَرَ تَصَرُّفَهُ فِي عَذَابِكَ،
transliteration: mā akthara taṣarrufahu fī ʿadhābika
english_text: How much he will move about in Thy chastisement!

arabic_text: وَمَا أَطْوَلَ تَرَدُّدَهُ فِيْ عِقَابِكَ،
transliteration: wa mā aṭwal taraddudahu fī ʿiqābika
english_text: How long he will frequent Thy punishment!

arabic_text: وَمَا أَبْعَدَ غَايَتَهُ مِنَ الْفَرَجِ،
transliteration: wa mā ʾabʿada ghāyatahu min al-faraj
english_text: How far his utmost end from relief!

arabic_text: وَمَا أَقْنَطَهُ مِنْ سُهُولَةِ الْمَخْرَجِ
transliteration: wa mā aqnathu min suhulati al-makhraj
english_text: How he will despair of an easy exit!

arabic_text: عَدْلاً مِنْ قَضَائِكَ لاَ تَجُورُ فِيهِ، وَإنْصَافاً مِنْ حُكْمِكَ لاَ تَحِيفُ عَلَيْهِ،
transliteration: ʿadlan min qaḍāʾika lā tajūru fīhi wa-inṣāfan min ḥukmika lā taḥīfu ʿalayhi
english_text: [All of this] as justice from Thy decree (Thou art not unjust in it!), and equity from Thy judgement (Thou dost not act wrongfully against him!).

arabic_text: فَقَدْ ظَاهَرْتَ الْحُجَجَ، وَأَبْلَيْتَ الاعْذَارَ، وَقَـدْ تَقَدَّمْتَ بِـالْوَعِيْـدِ وَتَلَطَّفْتَ فِي التَّرْغِيْبِ، وَضَرَبْتَ الامْثَالَ، وَأَطَلْتَ الاِمْهَالَ، وَأَخَّرْتَ وَأَنْتَ مُسْتَطِيعٌ لِلْمُعَاجَلَةِ،
transliteration: faqad ẓahartal-ḥujaja wa ablaytal-iʿḏāra wa qad taqaddamta bil waʿīd wa taltaffat fi al-targhīb waḍarabta al-amthāl, wa-aṭalt al-imhāl wa'akhkhirta wa anta mustaṭīʿun lilmuʿājalati
english_text: Thou supported the arguments, tested the excuses, began with threats, showed gentleness with encouragement, struck similitudes, made long the respite, delayed, while Thou art able to hurry,
